name: Agape Academy International
title: A school’s story, told online
description: A Christian school in Pantang West, Ghana, for ages 3 to 18, with its academics, student life and admissions in one place.
summary: Academic excellence. Christian character. Global purpose.
overview: Agape Academy International is a Christian school in Pantang West, Ghana, educating young people from age 3 to 18. It combines academic study with character development and a global outlook.

Its site brings the school together for families: the philosophy behind it, programmes for every stage, student life, a gallery, and a clear path to apply, book a visit or request information. ZIIV worked with the school on the project.
